# watchpoint_resource_acl (Resource)

Pins one role or one member to specific monitors, dashboards, status pages or RUM sites. A subject with no grants of a kind is not narrowed for that kind at all, so adding the first grant is what switches narrowing on, and removing the last one switches it off again. Tenant Owners and Admins are never narrowed. `patterns` is the complete set for this subject and kind: a grant added outside Terraform is removed on the next apply. The id is `<resource_kind>/role/<role_id>` or `<resource_kind>/user/<user_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pin the payments on-call role to the monitors it owns. Members of the role can
# open and list only these; every other kind (dashboards, status pages, RUM
# sites) is untouched, because each kind is narrowed independently.
resource "watchpoint_resource_acl" "payments_monitors" {
  resource_kind = "monitor"
  role_id       = watchpoint_role.payments_oncall.id
  label         = "Payments monitors"

  patterns = [
    watchpoint_http_monitor.checkout.id,
    watchpoint_http_monitor.refunds.id,
  ]
}

# A prefix glob covers a fleet without listing it. Use "*" to grant every
# resource of the kind, which is how you narrow one kind while leaving another
# wide open on purpose.
resource "watchpoint_resource_acl" "payments_dashboards" {
  resource_kind = "dashboard"
  role_id       = watchpoint_role.payments_oncall.id
  patterns      = ["dash_payments-*"]
}

# A grant can name a single member instead of a role. Exactly one of role_id or
# user_id is set.
resource "watchpoint_resource_acl" "contractor_status_page" {
  resource_kind = "status_page"
  user_id       = "usr_contractor"
  patterns      = [watchpoint_status_page.public.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `patterns` (Set of String) The resources this subject may reach, as the complete set. Each entry is a resource ID, a prefix glob such as `mon_payments-*`, or `*` for every resource of the kind. Matching is case-insensitive. Removing an entry revokes it on the next apply.
- `resource_kind` (String) Kind of resource being narrowed: `monitor`, `dashboard`, `status_page`, `rum_site`, `environment`. Each kind is narrowed independently, so granting monitors says nothing about dashboards. Changing it replaces the grant.

### Optional

- `label` (String) Optional display name shown beside the grant in the portal, which otherwise falls back to the raw pattern. The API only accepts a label when the row is created, so changing it replaces the grant. Never refreshed from the API.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the tenant role the grant applies to. Exactly one of `role_id` or `user_id` is required. The role must exist in this organization. Changing it replaces the grant.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member the grant applies to. Exactly one of `role_id` or `user_id` is required. The member must be active in this organization. Changing it replaces the grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ACL grant ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<resource_kind>/role/<role_id>" or "<resource_kind>/user/<user_id>".
terraform import watchpoint_resource_acl.payments_monitors monitor/role/role_001
```
